desc:
🐾 Welcome to [⭐] MFR Collectible Pets!

Hatch, raise, trade and roleplay with friends in a world full of adorable pets!

🎯 What You Can Do:
🥚 Hatch eggs with 700+ pets, from common to legendary!
🌈 Make Neon and Mega Neon pets!
🦄 Ride and fly your favorite pets!
🔁 Trade pets to complete your collection!
🏠 Decorate your own house – dozens of styles!
🎭 Roleplay with friends in a lively, social world!

🌟 Special Features:
🎡 Lucky Wheel – spin for prizes!
💰 Paychecks – earn Bucks just for playing!
💖 Pet, feed and care for your pets to grow them up!
👗 Dress up your pets and your avatar!
🔨 Regular bug fixes and performance improvements

📢 Server Shutdown = Update 

👥 Join our group for a FREE Fan Role:
https://www.roblox.com/communities/15355828

⭐ LIKE & FAVORITE to support future updates!
